name: sql-mcp
description: A Model Context Protocol server for interacting with MSSQL and PostgreSQL databases, offering tools for schema exploration and SQL execution. It features configurable query modes for safety and supports advanced authentication methods like Windows Auth and SSL.

rawRecord.description: A Model Context Protocol server for interacting with MSSQL and PostgreSQL databases, offering tools for schema exploration and SQL execution. It features configurable query modes for safety and supports advanced authentication methods like Windows Auth and SSL.

SQL_MCP_MODE.description: Control query permissions. 'safe' (default) allows SELECT, WITH, EXPLAIN. 'write' allows safe operations plus INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE. 'full' allows all operations including CREATE, DROP, ALTER, TRUNCATE.
